metadataRaw.title: How to Decompress Your Back for Instant Sciatica Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your back for instant sciatica pain relief.

These exercises will focus on deep pulling motions, known as decompression traction, to quickly take pressure off the lower back. 

This includes taking pressure off bulging or herniated lumbar spinal discs that may be leading to a pinched nerve (the main cause of sciatica).

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give sciatica relief within seconds.

Watch now and decompress your lower back for quick sciatica pain relief!
